components.name: Action Download Button
components.description: Flat bordered CV PDF download button with audience sublabel and 44px touch floor.
components.html: Full Research CV (PDF)
components.css: .ds-btn-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; background: var(--entry, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--border, #eeeeee); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--primary, #1e1e1e); font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: none; transition: background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-action:hover { background: var(--tertiary, #d6d6d6); border-color: var(--accent-pine-mid, #3E7060); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-pine, #203931); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Metadata Pill Chip
components.description: High-contrast pill chip using primary ink on tertiary surface fill.
components.css: .ds-chip-pill { display: inline-block; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--tertiary, #d6d6d6); color: var(--primary, #1e1e1e); border: 1px solid var(--border, #eeeeee); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Flat Monograph Card
components.description: Flat 1px-bordered card container without ambient shadows or colored glows.
components.html:
Climate Commons

Schema-validated workflows for Earth system prediction.
components.css: .ds-card-flat { background: var(--entry, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--border, #eeeeee); border-radius: 8px; padding: 20px; color: var(--primary, #1e1e1e); box-shadow: none; transition: transform 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-card-flat:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: var(--accent-pine-mid, #3E7060); } .ds-card-flat h3 { margin: 0 0 8px 0; font-size: 1.1rem; } .ds-card-flat p { margin: 0; font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--secondary, #6c6c6c); }

components.name: Publication Filter Input
components.description: Flat search input with leading SVG icon and explicit :focus-visible outline.
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; } .ds-input-icon { position: absolute; left: 14px; color: var(--secondary, #6c6c6c); pointer-events: none; } .ds-input-filter { width: 100%; padding: 10px 38px 10px 42px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--entry, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--border, #eeeeee); color: var(--primary, #1e1e1e); font-size: 0.95rem; box-shadow: none; } .ds-input-filter:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #1e1e1e); outline-offset: 2px; border-color: var(--primary, #1e1e1e); }

components.name: Section Anchor Nav Pill
components.description: Compact section jump link used in .cv-nav-bar and .pub-year-nav.
components.css: .ds-nav-pill { display: inline-block; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--tertiary, #d6d6d6); color: var(--primary, #1e1e1e); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-pill:hover { background: var(--border, #eeeeee); } .ds-nav-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-pine, #203931); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Progressive CV Disclosure
components.description: Native <details> summary control for secondary CV sections, expanding automatically for print and anchors.
components.html: Show all 28 trainings & certifications
components.css: .ds-cv-summary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; background: var(--entry, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--border, #eeeeee); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--primary, #1e1e1e); font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; } .ds-cv-summary:hover { background: var(--tertiary, #d6d6d6); border-color: var(--accent-pine-mid, #3E7060); } .ds-cv-summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-pine, #203931); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.northStar: The Applied Mathematician's Monograph & Lab Notebook
narrative.overview:
This design system unifies technical research depth with minimalist engineering restraint. Long-form technical articles, KaTeX derivations, Fortran kernels, and fluid-dynamics visualizations occupy one aligned 720px centered column anchored by crisp sans-serif headings and hairline dividers.

Color and motion stay strictly subordinate to reading comprehension and operational speed. Neutrals carry the canvas and card geometry, while deep pine and ocean accents mark interactive links, selections, blockquote hairlines, active states, and structural highlights across both light and dark modes.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial Clarity: Uniform sans-serif headings paired with calm hairline section dividers (--border) and a centered 720px (~66ch) column.
Flat Tactility: Crisp 1px borders without resting ambient shadows or colored glow halos.
Heritage Accents: Deep pine and ocean ink tokens adapted explicitly for light and dark surfaces at >= 4.5:1 WCAG AA contrast.
Operational Restraint: Progressive <details> disclosures, instant CSS Highlights filtering, and lightweight local video facades.

rules.name: The Heritage Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Reserve deep pine and ocean exclusively for section rules, inline links, active selections, and interactive emphasis; never flood card backgrounds with saturated brand fills.

rules.name: The Pill Contrast Rule
rules.body: Never render small pill, tag, or badge text in --secondary over --tertiary; always use --primary (or dedicated WCAG AA semantic tokens) to maintain >= 4.5:1 contrast.

rules.name: The Unified Column Measure Rule
rules.body: Keep .main centered at max-width: calc(var(--main-width) + var(--gap) * 2) (720px content column) so headings, prose paragraphs, rules, figures, and /cv/ entries share exact left and right edges without desktop voids.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Apply font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on .metric-value, .pub-year-pill, .cv-date-badge, and table td so numeric benchmarks and CV dates align cleanly.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Cards, inputs, covers, and play buttons carry zero resting box-shadow and zero colored glow halos; depth is expressed solely through 1px borders and clean surface hierarchy.

dos: Do use --accent-pine (#203931 / #6ee7b7) and --accent-ocean (#09434e / #7dd3fc) for structural hairlines, prose links, selections, and interactive emphasis.
Do keep all cards flat (1px solid var(--border), box-shadow: none) and use var(--primary) for text on --tertiary pills.
Do preserve sans-serif display headings with clean 1px solid var(--border) hairlines on section h2s and align all content inside PaperMod's centered 720px column.
Do declare explicit dimensions (width/height) on media, tabular-nums on numeric badges/tables, and beforeprint/@media print expansion on <details>.
donts: Don't add colored blurred shadows (dark-glow), bounce easing (1.56), thick colored border-left side-tabs on cards, or nested cards inside cards.
Don't use var(--secondary) text inside .post-tag, .software-tag, .sim-spec-pill, .cv-date-badge, .cv-skills-tag, or .pub-year-pill.
Don't replace native <button>/<details> controls with <div> click handlers or inject raw HTML via innerHTML.
Don't modify anything inside the read-only themes/PaperMod/ submodule.
